description: Re-meshes or format-converts an existing 3D model from a prior Meshy task or a public model URL (Meshy Remesh).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

convert_format_only.description: When true, only change the file format(s) and skip remeshing (ignores target_polycount, topology, resize_height).

input_task_id.description: Task id of a previously-completed Meshy text/image/multi-image to 3D task whose output you want to remesh. Mutually exclusive with `model_url`.

origin_at.description: Where to place the origin ("bottom", "center"). Empty string leaves the origin unchanged.

resize_height.description: Resize the model to this height in meters. 0 leaves the model at its original size.

target_formats.description: List of output mesh formats to produce. Defaults to ['glb'].
